ctx.x: studio. See, I never got involved with the higher-ups, you know what I mean, because they were... As far as Russell was concerned... He did all the business where I was concerned. I know one of them was named Jack Something... Jack Kapp. Jack Kapp. I think he was from Okeh Records. I think, I'm not sure it was Jack Kapp. Then there was another fellow... Boy, I can't remember his name now.
See, I had no business with them. You know what I mean...
